firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently went to the cinema is the Director for the first round.
clarifications: The other players are Casting agents in that round.
The player to the left of the previous Director becomes the new Director for the next round.
internalEvidence: Rendered pages 2 and 4 of the publisher-hosted English rules give the recent-cinema criterion and leftward Director rotation. The booklet credits Blue Cocker Games and In Ludo Veritas ©2015; Casting agency screens, Director cards and candidate tickets match inventory BGG 175150.
